name: CVN Kalari Sangham
summary: CVN Kalari Sangham is a Kalarippayattu school at East Fort, Thiruvananthapuram, established in 1956. It runs year-round training for local and foreign students, gives performances and workshops, and has a clinic for traditional Ayurvedic orthopaedic treatment.
highlights: Established in 1956, the year Kerala state was formed
Year-round Kalarippayattu training for local and foreign students
Performances and workshops in India and abroad
Kalarichikitsa clinic for Ayurvedic orthopaedic treatment
